executeSQLs: CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS card_counter DEFAULT CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `users` (`id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `openid` varchar(64) NOT NULL, `nickname` varchar(128) DEFAULT '', `avatar_url` varchar(512) DEFAULT '', `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (`id`), UNIQUE KEY `openid` (`openid`)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `quotas` (`id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `local_id` varchar(64) DEFAULT '', `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL, `merchant` varchar(128) NOT NULL, `item` varchar(128) NOT NULL, `amount` decimal(10,2) DEFAULT 0.00, `total_times` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, `used_times` int(11) DEFAULT 0, `expire_date` date DEFAULT NULL, `note` text, `preferences` json DEFAULT NULL, `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (`id`), KEY `user_id` (`user_id`), KEY `local_id` (`local_id`)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `checkins` (`id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `local_id` varchar(64) DEFAULT '', `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL, `quota_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL, `quota_local_id` varchar(64) DEFAULT '', `merchant` varchar(128) DEFAULT '', `deduct_times` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, `checkin_date` date DEFAULT NULL, `checkin_time` varchar(32) DEFAULT '', `is_revoked` tinyint(1) DEFAULT 0, `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (`id`), KEY `user_id` (`user_id`), KEY `local_id` (`local_id`)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `ratings` (`id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `local_id` varchar(64) DEFAULT '', `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL, `merchant` varchar(128) NOT NULL, `score` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 5, `comment` text, `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (`id`), KEY `user_id` (`user_id`), KEY `local_id` (`local_id`)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;
